name: transcribe
description: Timed transcript of a local audio or video file, from whisper.cpp on this Mac.

verbs.name: file
verbs.description: Transcribe one file. Prints the text, or the transcript with --json. Cached by file hash, model, and language.

path.description: Audio or video file to transcribe.

model.description: whisper.cpp model name from huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp, such as small or large-v3-turbo-q5_0.

language.description: Language code such as en. Detected when omitted.

verbs.name: srt
verbs.description: Same as file, but prints SubRip subtitles. The --json output is the transcript.

path.description: Audio or video file to transcribe.

model.description: whisper.cpp model name from huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp, such as small or large-v3-turbo-q5_0.

language.description: Language code such as en. Detected when omitted.
